reviewHolds.message: Amber columns are proposed location markers, not designed sections. No foundation/rebar/capacity certification.
Zero-right setback and external WC location remain unverified for municipal submission.
18 risers, tread/landing dimensions and a real slab void coordinated; structural waist/beam/guard details and finished headroom need professional checking.
Static vehicle fits with a clear right approach. Driving/turning/gate operation still unverified.
NBC 205 coverage cap 92.90304 m2 is exceeded; use project-specific NBC 105 engineering. Missing M08 is excluded, not an active dependency.

notes: Selected soak point overlaps existing outside WC; retain exact owner pin and flag collision.
Septic outer envelope crosses plinth by 452 mm at the selected centre; do not silently move it.
Mechanical exhaust discharges to outside air, never into a sewage vent.
No supply-water/drain cross-connections. Rainwater stays independent.
Vent extension 900 mm above terrace is a coordination assumption; termination separation from openings remains to be resolved.
E conduit illustrates distribution only; earthing, circuit protection and cable sizes are not designed.
